sermon.title: Redemption without Restoration is Not Salvation Pt 2
sermon.series: Redemption Without Restoration Is Not Salvation
sermon.speaker: Pastor Kincer
sermon.summary: God proclaimed a sign and backs His word. Adversaries will come, but we must give God our time and overcome excuses. Leviticus 19 calls us to rebuke without hate and respect others. He applies this to abortion, politics and faith, urging Christians to approach sinners as individuals.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

chunks.section_question: Did the early church have adversaries?
chunks.short_answer: Yes—Rome and religious leaders; keep preaching; later the work ceased; God backs His word.
chunks.text:
Then they had adversaries. How many of you know the early church apostles and people had adversaries? The Roman government, the people, the local people in the community. But 2 Thessalonians 2:3, let no man deceive you. That day shall not come except there come a what? Falling away first. 2 Timothy 4:3. The time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine, but after their own lust shall they heap to themselves teachers having tickling ears. They shall turn away. In other words, we want you to tell us what we want to hear. They will turn away their ears from the truth and shall be turned into fables. But watch you in all things. Even during this adversity, you be alert. Endure the afflictions and do the work of a what? Evangelist. See, evangelist is an in gatherer.

See, keep preaching, keep prophesying, keep encouraging. Don’t let it get you. This is going to happen. And did it happen? Yeah. The dark ages. 500-,500 years. There’s very little voice about Jesus, the word, and building the church. The the Catholic Church had gone into gross darkness and gross sin. Just horrible. Now, that’s you know, they got to they got to measure up. They they got to accept the fact they botched it up. Just read your history. And then just like the Bible said, the work ceased. The whole world was turned upside down in the apostles days.

And then a few hundred years go by and the work ceased. They stopped building God’s house. So what do we learn? Jesus made a proclamation to what? Build a church. A sign was given. He was born of a virgin. He was named hundreds of years before he came. He died. He had to lay down his life and he rose again. I mean, do we have a sign or what? Yeah. Is it time to build God’s house or is it just time to build our own family? It’s time to build God’s house along with our family. Did Jesus stir up their spirits in the book of Acts in the New Testament church?

chunks.section_question: How do we treat a sinning neighbor?
chunks.short_answer: Rebuke him without hating; respect seniors and strangers; Christians don’t do tattoos.
chunks.text:
But you shall surely rebuke your neighbor. Correct. Okay. The neighbor’s wrong. You what? Correct them. It’s not even your brother, just those around you. Least you incur sin because of him. Least you invite sin or permit sin. See, if you don’t stand up and speak the word of God, which is the spirit, then your absence of speaking is permitting sin in people’s lives and in your community and in your nation. And you cannot win over your adversaries with that kind of attitude, can you?

See, in America, we can’t permit sin. We can’t invite sin by being silent. And we can’t hate those who are violating God’s word. You got that? Now, this is tough. You really need the Holy Ghost and a real word of God for this kind of level of growth of Christianity. Hallelujah. Now, let’s continue. Now, I I want to remind you, he’s saying this statement in the midst of these laws about the poor. Take care of the poor by not gathering all your crops in. They can go out and work and gather it in.

The poor can get it. Seniors, respect seniors. Stand up. Give older people respect. See, strangers, respect strangers. Don’t mistreat strangers, foreigners, people outside your race line or your religious line or your social status line. Don’t mistreat other people. He’s saying this right in the middle of all these laws that he wrote. Don’t steal. Don’t lie. No immoral sexual activity, incest, homosexuality, adultery, fornication, sex with animals, it’s all included in there. You see, witchcraft don’t have anything to do with witchcraft. Tattoos. Well, everybody’s getting them.

I’m going to get me one. Now, Christians don’t do tattoos. Hallelujah. Okay, people do that and they have fat haircuts, you know, don’t cut your hair for a certain cause or a certain reason, you know, just just be normal. He’s saying be normal and right judgment. He said, “Judge, right judgment.” And when you do business, have perfect scales. Don’t cheat people and judge what? Right judgment. Make right decisions. Right in the middle of all this, he comes up with now don’t hate these people that are violating it, but don’t allow them to permit sin in the land and by your silence invite sin in the land.

They’re going to turn other people to their sin, their crime. You understand that? But you got to do it without despising, hating them, and looking down on them. Why? Because they’re part of the restoration. God wants to what? Restore them. You shall not take vengeance. Oh, I’m going to fix these people. No, you shall not take vengeance. You don’t have vengeance in your heart. Or bear any grudge against the sons of your people, these people that are sinning, harboring bad feelings. You see, you can’t hate Obama. I don’t care if you like him or not in his politics. You’re not allowed as a Christian to hate him.

scriptures.text_nkjv: ‘You shall not hate your brother in your heart. You shall surely rebuke your neighbor, and not bear sin because of him. You shall not take vengeance, nor bear any grudge against the children of your people, but you shall love your neighbor as yourself: I am the LORD.

‘You shall rise before the gray headed and honor the presence of an old man, and fear your God: I am the LORD. ‘And if a stranger dwells with you in your land, you shall not mistreat him. The stranger who dwells among you shall be to you as one born among you, and you shall love him as yourself; for you were strangers in the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.
You shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor tattoo any marks on you: I am the LORD.

chunks.short_answer: Correcting without despising—get them to listen to your cause; give understanding.
chunks.text:
You understand that? And Christians get mad at me for this, but it’s true. I have to keep a right attitude about this. And I’ll show you why. But you shall love your neighbor as yourself. If you mess up, how do you want them treating you to correct you? You want them to hate you, ban you from the community, lock you in prison for life because you stole a loaf of bread. Are you there? Are you wanting them because of your stand for right to stone you just because you’re standing for right?

Or do you want them to listen to your cause? Are you out there now? See, this is maturity. And this is the first and second commandment. All the apostles, I mean, all the prophets, all the law is based on love God and love your neighbor as yourself. Isn’t that right? And right in the middle of all these sins, he makes this commandment. Love these people that are sinning and correct them. So, do we need to speak out in America? Yeah. Who do we need to speak out to? The ones who are violating what is right and the Christians who through lack of understanding are backing up the ones who are violating what’s right because they haven’t taken time to get the understanding.

So, we need to what? Give them the understanding so they can be a wise and understanding and strong people. Can I hear an amen? Amen. Does that make sense? Hallelujah. Now, here’s our enemies in our generation. This is our enemies. Homosexuals talk horrible about Jesus and the Bible. The Bible isn’t a book of truth. It’s fairy tales. Jesus is not God. Not even a real person. And the Bible’s a bunch of BS. I’m working on a brochure called BS. Cuz that’s what they call the Bible, BS. All right. I can’t say the word, but I can print it. Pro-choice.

chunks.short_answer: As individuals, without hate, so God can change their life.
chunks.text:
I have to approach them as an individual and get them to listen to my cause so that God can change their life. I cannot hate the homosexual. That’s why I’ve led 53 homosexuals to Christ. I don’t have anything personal against them. I totally disagree with them. And I only have to tell them they’re wrong because they can be saved. They can repent. And we need homosexuality and abortion to get back into the darkness like it was before. Not out in the open. We’re not wanting to kill anybody according to Leviticus. Isn’t that right? We just don’t want it promoted in the land as something that is truth when it’s not true.

Can I hear an amen? Yeah. You know, get back in the closet. Don’t get out here telling our kids. Don’t get on TV promoting it. Get back in the closet. I’m hoping I’ve given you something to think on.
